historicalDefinition: Official toll and vignette authority registry with jurisdiction, update cadence and effective dates
historicalRuntimeDependency: Runtime-ready AGM Toll Library specification and verified source-update runbook

rows.requirement: One governed official authority record per required jurisdiction
rows.authority: AGM internal authority only; zero external official toll authorities in the 815-source registry
rows.residualGap: Ten-jurisdiction official authority set is not in the Central Registry
rows.proposedAction: Acquire and human-review the official candidates; request a separate atomic registry mandate only after integrity capture

rows.requirement: Jurisdiction coverage: DE, AT, CH, FR, BE, NL, LU, PL, CZ, DK
rows.authority: Eleven Phase 2 official candidates remain outside the registry
rows.scope: National heavy-vehicle coverage is broadly discoverable; light/special infrastructure coverage is uneven
rows.residualGap: France is concession-fragmented; Luxembourg needs replacement review; several countries need passenger/light or special-infrastructure sources
rows.proposedAction: Build a per-jurisdiction canonical bundle rather than treating one landing page as complete coverage

rows.authority: No external authoritative vehicle-scope source in Central Registry
rows.scope: PASSENGER_CAR, LIGHT_COMMERCIAL, VAN, CAR_WITH_TRAILER, TRANSPORTER, TRUCK, TRACTOR_UNIT, OTHER_DRIVABLE_VEHICLE, UNKNOWN
rows.residualGap: Phase 2 candidates are predominantly heavy-goods sources; passenger cars, trailers, vans and exceptional infrastructure are not fully mapped
rows.proposedAction: Create explicit class-to-legal-band mappings; retain UNKNOWN as human confirmation, never zero/safe/pass

rows.scope: TOM/cache/conditional fallback architecture, not official tolled-network truth
rows.residualGap: No governed official route-segment/network artifact set for all ten jurisdictions
rows.proposedAction: Acquire official tolled-network/map artifacts and define source freshness per jurisdiction

rows.requirement: Current effective tariffs and vignette prices
rows.authority: No official tariff artifact in Central Registry
rows.scope: Rates by road, region, vehicle/weight/axle/emission class and effective date
rows.residualGap: Dynamic rates are discoverable but not integrity-captured; France grids are distributed by concession; effective-date refresh is not governed
rows.proposedAction: Capture immutable tariff artifacts where published and timestamp/hash dynamic pages

rows.authority: No external authoritative source in Central Registry
rows.scope: Passenger/light vehicles and time-based vignettes or fixed infrastructure tolls
rows.residualGap: AT and CZ require separate light-vehicle sources; DK bridges and NL A24 are separate systems; PL concession roads and other special facilities remain incomplete
rows.proposedAction: Add official operator/government candidates with explicit route and vehicle scope

rows.scope: Exemptions, out-of-scope vehicles, no-general-toll cases and non-stacking rules
rows.residualGap: Absence of a charge is not documented consistently; UNKNOWN cannot be inferred as zero
rows.proposedAction: Require an official negative-applicability basis before returning zero toll

rows.authority: Internal field cadence only; not a tariff update mechanism
rows.scope: Detect rate, network, class and law changes before operational use
rows.residualGap: No verified official-source update runbook with per-source cadence, invalidation and stale-data handling
rows.proposedAction: Design documentary update controls under a separate mandate; runtime activation remains out of scope

rows.authority: Phase 2 candidates have official URLs but null artifact SHA-256
rows.scope: Official final URL, capture timestamp, bytes/MIME/SHA-256 and authority owner
rows.residualGap: Candidate URLs are not equivalent to verified canonical artifacts
rows.proposedAction: Run remote canonical integrity acquisition before any authority proposal

rows.scope: Controlled field observations and non-conclusive partial data
rows.residualGap: No sufficient measured field sample; operational evidence cannot replace official toll truth
rows.proposedAction: Keep field results separate and non-conclusive until approved thresholds are met

rows.residualGap: None assigned to ROUTING-TOLL-001; source authority for toll overlays remains separate
rows.proposedAction: Do not broaden ROUTING-TOLL-001 into a routing-provider certification gap

rows.scope: Traffic restrictions and multi-jurisdiction professional-driver rules
